name: Remove the immediate-mode Ui::: API
body: Dean, 2026-10-30 (decision card): remove the engine's immediate-mode Ui::: API now that the game's UI is Chaos and Cosmos.

comments.text: Filed before starting, per Dean's standing rule.

plan:
- Delete crates/game-host/src/api/ui.rs and its registration, EngineState's ui and ui_column, the host's end-of-column step.
- Delete lantern_renderer_3d::ui (only the game host used it).
- Regenerate games/platformer/engine-host-surface.json.
- Docs: game-api.md, architecture.md (incl. the Umbra mapping row), D-044.
